drafts.review_basis: Complete modal double-faced card: creature Aura with +2/+2, flying and lifelink; the alternate land enters tapped and taps for white or black. Face choice uses ordinary cast or land-play permissions and limits. Off-stack/off-battlefield characteristics revert to the physical front face.

As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
This spell deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target.

drafts.review_basis: Complete modal double-faced card. Front reuses Fling's additional creature sacrifice and exact last-known power, with any-target damage; back is a tapped red-producing land. Costs remain paid if the spell is countered or its target becomes illegal.

faces.oracle_text:
Lifelink
Extort
At the beginning of each of your postcombat main phases, if you gained 3 or more life this turn, exile Sorin, then return him to the battlefield transformed under his owner's control.

Extort
[+2]: Create a Food token.
[−1]: Sorin deals damage equal to the amount of life you gained this turn to any target.
[−6]: Gain control of target creature. It becomes a Vampire in addition to its other types. Put a lifelink counter on it if you control a white permanent other than that creature or Sorin.

drafts.review_basis: Complete transforming card and both extort abilities. The postcombat-main intervening condition uses total life gained this turn, including before entry. Exact exile/return uses the owner's control and back-face entry loyalty. Food reuses the reviewed token. Loyalty damage uses total life gained; ultimate control and added Vampire subtype persist indefinitely, while the lifelink-counter condition excludes the stolen creature and Sorin.

faces.oracle_text:
Extort
Other creatures you control have extort.

drafts.review_basis: Complete printed extort and one independently granted extort instance on each other controlled creature. Grants follow current continuous effects and ability removal. Each cast trigger offers one optional white-or-black payment and gains the total actual opponent life loss, without targets.

faces.oracle_text: When this Siege enters, search your library for an Aura, God, or Demigod card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

Ephara has lifelink and indestructible as long as you control at least three other enchantments.
Whenever another enchantment you control enters, draw a card.

drafts.review_basis: Complete Siege, defense four, protector selection, combat and intrinsic defeat trigger. Defeat exiles the exact permanent and offers its physical transforming back face as a free cast. Search selects Aura, God or Demigod cards; Ephara draws for other enchantments and gains lifelink/indestructible with at least three other controlled enchantments. Back-face color indicator is white-blue.

faces.oracle_text:
I — Search your library for a basic Plains card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
II — You may discard a card. When you do, return target permanent card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
III — Exile this Saga, then return it to the battlefield transformed under your control.

Vigilance
Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, create a 1/1 colorless Spirit creature token.

drafts.review_basis: Complete Saga chapters and transformed Architect face. Saga entry and precombat-main lore cross chapter thresholds, and final sacrifice waits for pending chapter abilities. Chapter I searches a basic Plains. Chapter II optionally discards before a separate reflexive trigger chooses its return target, including the discarded permanent. Chapter III returns transformed under the effect controller. Architect has vigilance and creates a colorless Spirit when attacking or blocking.

drafts.review_basis: Complete Saga lifecycle and chapters. Chapter I exiles an opposing permanent with mana value at least three.
